spec_case: issue #720: the agent tool times out mid-session
description: `params.session` names an existing session, so the session already has an id when its only turn times out: the effect ends `ok: false` with `meta.raw.session_id`/`transcript`(`null`, no turn completed)/`timed_out: true`, absorbed by `on_error: continue`. The fake ignores SIGTERM and sleeps until the engine kills its whole process group.
